name: No API key setup
description: Agent has no KAPIT_API_KEY set. Should tell user to sign up at https://kapit.dev/dashboard, create a key, and set the env var. Should NOT attempt authenticated calls. Should mention curl https://api.kapit.dev/llms.txt for discovery.
input: What's the current price of AAPL stock?
expected_behavior: Agent tells user it needs an API key
Agent directs user to https://kapit.dev/dashboard to sign up
Agent tells user to set KAPIT_API_KEY environment variable
Agent may mention llms.txt or /docs for discovery
Agent does not attempt any authenticated API call

name: Fetch stock quote
description: Agent has a valid KAPIT_API_KEY. User asks for AAPL price. Agent calls GET /v1/stocks/quotes/AAPL with Bearer auth and returns price + metadata.
expected_behavior: Agent calls GET /v1/stocks/quotes/AAPL with Authorization: Bearer header
Agent reads data.price from response
Agent reads meta.source.provider
Agent reads meta.rate_limit.remaining
Agent presents price, change, and source to user
Agent does not call unsupported endpoints

name: Crypto symbol uses CoinGecko ID
description: Agent should know crypto endpoint uses CoinGecko coin IDs (e.g. bitcoin), not tickers (BTC). If user says BTC, agent should auto-correct to bitcoin.
expected_behavior: Agent uses bitcoin (CoinGecko ID) not BTC (ticker) in the path
Agent calls GET /v1/crypto/prices/bitcoin
Or agent tries BTC, gets symbol_not_found, and auto-corrects to bitcoin
Agent returns price and 24h change

name: Handle rate limit on free tier
description: Agent on free tier receives 429 rate_limited error. Should read error.recovery and tell user to wait or upgrade — not retry immediately.
input: Get me the price of MSFT stock.
expected_behavior: Agent receives 429 with error.code = 'rate_limited'
Agent reads error.recovery.retry_after_seconds
Agent tells user quota is exhausted and provides wait time
Agent suggests upgrading at https://kapit.dev/dashboard
Agent does NOT retry immediately in a loop

name: Handle soft overage warning on paid tier
description: Agent on Starter/Builder/Scale tier receives 200 with meta.warning. Should notify user of overage but use the data.
expected_behavior: Agent receives 200 with meta.warning present
Agent notifies user that monthly quota is exceeded and overage applies
Agent uses the valid data in the response
Agent suggests upgrading

name: Check usage and rate limits
description: Agent should call GET /v1/usage to check current quota before batch requests.
input: How many API requests do I have left today?
expected_behavior: Agent calls GET /v1/usage
Agent reads data.requests_remaining and data.requests_limit
Agent reports remaining quota to user
Agent notes the tier and reset time

name: Avoid unsupported endpoints
description: Agent should NOT attempt historical, search, batch, or streaming endpoints. Only the four documented GET endpoints are available.
input: Show me the historical price of AAPL for the last 30 days.
expected_behavior: Agent recognizes that historical endpoints are not supported in V1
Agent tells user this feature is not available yet
Agent does NOT call any unsupported path
Agent offers alternatives: current quote via /v1/stocks/quotes/AAPL

name: Fetch Polymarket prediction market
description: Agent calls GET /v1/polymarket/markets/{market_id} and interprets outcomes/probabilities.
input: What are the odds on Polymarket for Bitcoin hitting an all-time high by September 2026?
expected_behavior: Agent calls GET /v1/polymarket/markets/bitcoin-all-time-high-by-september-30-2026
Agent parses data.outcomes for implied probabilities
Agent reports odds to user with context about volume and status
Agent notes that these are probabilities, not guarantees
